cost: O(argv bytes + script/interpreter work + import/export bytes + journal bytes). VMbench performs six runs per source, mcgate defaults 20000; neither is run for this modeling epoch.
description: CLI dispatch for code execution, filesystem flags, suite utilities, VM diagnostics and Monte Carlo gateway.
forward: main selects command; run/-e parse FS options then open/import, instantiate interpreter, execute and finalize exports/journal. Script false yields exit1, configuration/read/finalization error exit2, successful operation exit0. Other branches run explicit suites/bench/mcgate only when selected.
inverse: Failed script excludes configured export effects, but does not exclude journal write or earlier imports. Nonmem with imports/exports is rejected inside run_code by fs_opts, excluding make_fs/import, interpreter execution and finalization, but not run_code invocation. This is CLI policy, not arbitrary filesystem isolation proof.

Exit2 admits usage, source read, options, backend initialization or finalization errors. Exit0 does not uniquely reconstruct arguments or successful code; last FS flags and first fault flag collapse many argv sequences.
limitations: Partial source-bound model, not semantic proof
Finite synthetic fixtures only; frozen suites/external measurement unexecuted
state: Real:virtual pair splits at first colon; repeated FS/limits/journal select last, repeated import/export accumulate. External suite and timing output are not deterministic timing guarantees.
